name: EVOCOM
recent: EVOCOM 于 2026 年 9 月 28 日在 ACE Market 上市，IPO 发售价为每股 RM0.18，首日股价较发售价下跌约 30%。公司随后在 10 月及 11 月发布了季度业绩，并出现董事及大股东在禁售期前后的持股变动公告。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 9 月 28 日在 Bursa Malaysia 的 ACE Market 上市，IPO 发售价为每股 RM0.18。
IPO 公开发售部分获超额认购 3.6 倍。
执行董事兼副首席执行官 Dr Esther Loo Chee Hong 于 2026 年 9 月 28 日通过场外交易以每股 RM0.13 增持 100,000 股。
risks: 执行董事兼首席执行官 Mr Ian Tan Kee Chuan 及副首席执行官 Dr Esther Loo Chee Hong 在季度业绩公布前的禁售期内表示有意进行证券交易。
公司上市首日股价较 IPO 发售价 RM0.18 下跌约 30%。

recent_en: EVOCOM listed on the ACE Market on 28 September 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.18 per share and fell about 30% on its debut. The company subsequently released quarterly results in October and November, with announcements of director and substantial shareholder dealings around the closed period.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia on 28 September 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.18 per share.
The public portion of the IPO was oversubscribed 3.6 times.
Executive Director and Deputy CEO Dr Esther Loo Chee Hong acquired 100,000 shares via off-market transaction at RM0.13 per share on 28 September 2026.
risks_en: Executive Director and CEO Mr Ian Tan Kee Chuan and Deputy CEO Dr Esther Loo Chee Hong indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period ahead of the quarterly results announcement.
The share price fell about 30% from the IPO price of RM0.18 on the first trading day.
